subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) She wrote many books like 'Paddarage', 'Motichur' etc. (b) Being educated she worked for women folk. (c) Begum Rokeya was the pioneer for the women to come out. (d) She wanted to break the chair of keeping inside home. (e) Her husband Sakhawat Hossain encouraged her to do so. (f) Begum Rokeya fought against all superstitions. (g) She worked for social welfare till death. (h) She set many schools especially open for the girls. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
guide_solution: Reordering sentences (c) + (d) + (b) + (g) + (e) + (h) + (f) + (a). Section B : Writing Test
